condition: Peri-operative warfarin for AF — no bridging
summary: Warfarin for atrial fibrillation before elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy: no bridging (BRIDGE).

inputs.chiefComplaint: Recurrent upper abdominal pain after meals
inputs.hpi: Three episodes of right upper quadrant pain after fatty meals over 6 months, each settling within hours. Ultrasound shows gallstones. Atrial fibrillation on warfarin.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Symptomatic gallstones (biliary colic)
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Symptomatic gallstones — planned elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy.

guideline.name: BRIDGE trial
guideline.citation: Douketis JD et al. N Engl J Med 2015;373:823-833.

rationale: BRIDGE: in AF, bridging did not reduce arterial thromboembolism (0.3% vs 0.4%) and doubled major bleeding (3.2% vs 1.3%).
